title: org-config-mcp-v2
description: An org config carrying the mcp v2 section, as pushed to the gateway. The shape is the OrgConfig definition of the admin contract; this file only points at it, so the two can never drift. Resolve the reference by registering ../agentcc-admin.schema.json under its $id. mcp.servers.<id>.credential.secret and mcp.managed_tools.credentials.<id>.secret exist only in pushed payloads, never in a saved config.
